messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 2026-05-14T08:12:25Z — Observed increased 5xx and elevated tail latency from eu-west hosted cache ring for generation endpoints. Automatic fallback to uncached path enabled. Status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1749012345 :warning:

Niya (oncall): I'm on it. Grafana shows sustained increase in request queue length on cache-shard-4 starting ~08:10Z. Tracing points to slower backend flushes.

Carlos (eng-sre): Logs show repeated "flush_delay" and backpressure signals from disk IO. Snippet:
```
[08:11:03] cache.flush: delay_ms=340
[08:11:10] cache.worker: backpressure asserted
```

Maya (support): Drafting customer note: "We're seeing temporary elevated errors and latency in eu-west hosted cache. Fallback is active so requests succeed but may be slower. We'll update as mitigations progress." Posting to #support-updates after validation.

Ethan (infra): Mitigation: increasing async flush workers, bumping IO queue size, and restarting two affected cache pods one at a time. Provisioning one spare node. ETA ~4m. Capturing logs to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1749012345/

Ruth (product): Confirm Dedicated/private unaffected? Need clarity for customer messaging.

Niya (oncall): Confirmed — Dedicated and Private customers unaffected. Incident limited to multi-tenant hosted ring in eu-west. Fallback preserves correctness.

ops-bot: Update 08:17Z — restarts and config bump in progress, error rate trending down. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv-cache/eu-west?orgId=1

Carlos (eng-sre): Error rate down from 3.2% -> 0.7%. Still a small tail spike on one host; isolating and draining it now.

Maya (support): Customer note sent to priority list. Status page updated.

Ethan (infra): Drained problematic host; additional node healthy. Leaving fallback enabled for 10m to confirm stability.

Niya (oncall): Postmortem owners: Carlos + Ethan. Current status: mitigation active, fallbacks in place, no data loss. Closing criteria: error rate <0.2% and tail latency within baseline for 10m. Next update in 10m or on change.

ops-bot: Will auto-post final update when criteria met. :white_check_mark:
